title: Rocket Dash
description: Guide a cheerful little rocket through wide gates, collect stars and power-ups, and try to beat your best distance.
bestFor: quick reflexes, easy controls, and repeat runs.
controls: tap/click or use Space, Arrow Up, or W to boost.
glance: tap or press Space, Arrow Up, or W to thrust.
short: Guide a rocket through gates, collect stars and power-ups, and beat your best distance.
about: A one-tap arcade game. Tap to thrust a little rocket through a bright, scrolling sky, thread it between gates, collect stars and power-ups, and beat your best distance. Stars you collect can be spent to keep a run going.
saves: your best distance and your bank of collected stars
